correctness.rationale: A complete two-direction run-end proof establishes the cyclic characterization for all n, including n<=3. Four length-four forbidden factors are exactly equivalent to the binary local condition. The exact eight-state adjacency graph has N_n=tr(A^n) by a bijection of periodic words and closed walks. Symmetric and antisymmetric three-state blocks have checked characteristic polynomials λ³−λ−1 and λ³+λ−1; determinant/log expansion establishes the zeta and both recurrences. The six-state core has cycles of lengths three and four, hence Perron–Frobenius spectral radius the plastic constant; Möbius inversion gives exact primitive orbit counts. Exhaustive direct enumeration checks 262,142 binary words through n=17, with transfer-vs-recurrence checks for 100 periods; finite cases corroborate but do not prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: For the first separated positive-shift pair beyond the rigid (1,2) binary case, the result characterizes the entire nonconstant cyclic family by a sharp local run rule, gives all labeled periodic-point and primitive-orbit counts, and computes the positive entropy exactly as log of the plastic constant. This establishes a structural positive-entropy transition and quantitative orbit theory on a natural infinite class, not just finite experimentation or routine restatement of the general transfer-matrix method.
